next.reason: 1985: 'If identifier-1 is defined in the Report Section, identifier-1 must reference a sum counter. ... or in a report group which is at a lower level'; 2023: 'Data-name-1 shall be the name of a numeric data item in the report section. ... The current report group may be a page footing'. 2023 lets the report-section addend be any numeric item, not only a sum counter, and allows more group pairings: detail to detail, page/report footing, other reports.
